Vars.AdjacentAlliesToEnemyTarget: GameState.GetActorsInRange(EnemyTarget.ArrayIndex, 1).Where(obj != CrashingTide && obj.IsAdjacentTo(EnemyTarget) && CActor.AreActorsAllied(obj.Type, CActor.EType.Player, obj, null))

MiscVars.CanConsume: CustomAbility.GetAdjacentTiles(TargetingActor.Tile).Select(LivingActor).Where(obj != null && not obj.IsBoss  && CActor.AreActorsEnemies(obj.Type, CActor.EType.Player, obj, null) && obj.Tokens.GetAllNegativeConditions().Count >= 3).Count > 0

Vars.ValidateLOS: (MiscVars != null && CustomAbility.GetMiscVarBool(CurrentAbility, "ForceLOSBuff")) || !AllAliveMonsters.Any(obj != target && obj.Type == target.Type && CAIMoveNew.CheckLoS(obj.ArrayIndex, target.ArrayIndex))

Vars.EnemiesAdjacentToTarget: AliveAndKilledActors.Where(obj != EnemyTarget && obj.IsAdjacentTo(EnemyTarget) && CActor.AreActorsEnemies(obj.Type, Drifter.Type, obj, Drifter))

Vars.ActorsInRangeOfTarget: GameState.GetActorsInRange(TargetingActor, TargetingActor, Range, null, AbilityFilter, null, null, true)

Vars.ValidateHasAdjacentEnemies: GameState.GetActorsInRange(TargetingActor, TargetingActor, 1, null, EnemyFilter, null, null, true).Count > 0

Vars.ValidateHasEnemiesInRange: GameState.GetActorsInRange(TriggerActor, TriggerActor, 3, null, EnemyFilter, null, null, true).Count > 0

TargetingVars.AddValidActorsInRange: GameState.GetActorsInRange(Target, TargetingActor, 1, null, AbilityFilter, null, null, true)
GameState.GetActorsInRange(Target, TargetingActor, 1, null, AbilityFilter, null, null, true).Where(obj != Target)

Vars.ValidatePrevAbilityHappened: PrevAbility != null && PrevAbility.TilesSelected != null && PrevAbility.TilesSelected.Count > 0 && PrevAbility.AbilityHasHappened
